long_biography.plain_text:
SEI became Alfred West’s laboratory for changing how financial businesses use technology and organise work. The company’s first product simulated lending decisions for bank officers, but early fund-raising failed and forced West to design pricing and operations around cash flow. He later moved the business into investment advisory and money management, taking it public while preserving an unusually hands-on culture.

That culture was made visible at the Oaks campus: movable desks, no executive offices and contemporary art throughout the workplace. West and his daughter Paige founded the West Collection in 1996 to support emerging artists, using the company’s offices as rotating exhibition spaces. After 54 years as chief executive, West transferred leadership to career employee Ryan Hicke; independent director Carl Guarino later became chairman when West retired as chairman emeritus.

The Jr. suffix is retained in every identity anchor, and the 2026 SEI operating and board succession is documented to career employee Ryan Hicke and independent director Carl Guarino rather than inferred as a family transfer.

Current public sources report West's age but do not supply an exact birth date, and older age references are not precise enough to infer one. No birth day, month or year is proposed. Brooksville, Florida is proposed separately from a detailed interview profile.

Forbes and first-party sources directly establish founder-built wealth, but reliable sources do not characterise West's family wealth, business networks, financial security or launch support well enough to distinguish an independent from an advantaged start. Broad Self-made preserves the positive founder evidence without reasoning from silence.

The latest located ownership filing records a substantial direct SEI shareholding immediately before West's January 2026 retirement, but the dossier does not infer a current percentage or complete asset allocation. Finance & Investments remains the strongest evidenced current sector from direct ownership and Forbes' wealth attribution.

Searches for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X/Twitter, YouTube and a personal website produced company posts, company accounts or identity-insecure name matches rather than an official personal account. Only the verified Forbes page and official SEI company website are proposed.

Asset management captures the money-management business behind West's wealth. Art collector adds an independent cultural dimension supported by a large, multi-decade collection rather than routine giving.
